training.title: GRAK'S RECRUITS
training.safe: Take your time. The defense resumes when you place someone.
training.starting_gold: Gunners cost 50 gold each. You have enough for two.
training.funding: +{gold} gold to pay for this recruit.
training.plan: Place a defender to resume. Waves follow automatically; p pauses, n sends the next early.
training.locked: This defender joins later. Build with the recruits you have.
training.gunner: Start by putting one or two Gunners near the entrance, covering the same road. They fire quickly, aiming at one fighter at a time. Move with arrows or WASD, choose a Gunner with 1, then Enter or click to place.
training.frost: Put her near or in front of the gunners on the path. Frost slows fighters and stops Rogues from evading shots.
training.cannon: Place a cannon. Cannon's do splash damage and pair well with frost mages. Blasts deal full damage through Paladin plate and Rogue evasion.
training.ranger: Place a Ranger where she can cover a long section of the path. Her arrows deal full damage through Centurion wards. Select her and press t to change targets. Strongest makes her aim at the fighter with the most health.
training.slingers: Place Slingers close to the path. They're cheap and fire quickly, but have a short range. Pair them with a frost mage to stop Rogues from evading their shots. They do little damage to Paladins.
training.lightning: Place a Lightning Mage near a section of the path where fighters bunch up. His lightning jumps between nearby fighters and pairs well with frost mages. Centurion wards block 80% of his damage, so keep Gunners or Rangers nearby.
training.trebuchet: Place a Trebuchet where it can cover several sections of the path. It fires slowly, but has a long range and does splash damage over a wide area. Pair it with a frost mage to keep fighters in range. Blasts deal full damage through Paladin plate and Rogue evasion.
training.runeforge: Place a Runeforge at the end of a straight section of the path, aiming along it. Its beam damages every fighter it hits. Use [ ] to switch to specialists, 1 to choose it, and r to rotate it. Pair it with a frost mage to keep fighters in the beam longer. You can place one per level.
training.hookmaster: Place a Hookmaster near your Gunners, Rangers or other damage dealers. He pulls fighters back along the path so they stay in range longer. Heavy fighters get pulled less, and champions barely move. Fighters recover between pulls and eventually resist them. You can place one per level.
training.sappers: Place Sappers near the path. They plant mines, including between waves, that do splash damage when fighters cross them. Blasts deal full damage through Paladin plate and Rogue evasion. Weaker fighters can use up mines before heavier ones arrive. Selling the Sappers removes their mines. You can place one per level.
training.witch: Place a Witch near your other defenders, covering the same section of the path. She marks fighters so they take more damage from your other defenders. She does no damage herself and starts by targeting the fighter with the most health. Marks don't stack. You can place one per level.
training.next_defense: Hold the Rotunda first. Specialists join during the next guided defense.
training.after_wave: Joins after wave {wave}. Once recruited, stays available on retries.

help_guide.goal: Survive all 20 waves to win. Each enemy that gets through costs you 1 HP; champions cost 6. Spend gold to build and upgrade your defenses. You earn more by killing enemies and clearing waves.
help_guide.opening: Start with two Gunners near the entrance, both covering the same stretch of road. When you can afford it, add a Frost Mage to slow enemies within the Gunners' range. Bends and looping paths give your defenders more time to shoot.
help_guide.modes: The campaign introduces recruits, unlocks maps, and fills your journal. Quick Play offers the full defender roster and high scores, without changing campaign progress.
help_guide.lair_controls_tip: Move onto a floor and press Enter to defend it. Visit the Rotunda to spend relics or replay the opening and ending. On the Depths, type a seed to return to the same maze. Win a level without losing HP to earn relics: Easy gives 1, Normal 2, Hard 3.
help_guide.placement_tip: Green dots show where you can build now. Amber dots show valid spots where you need more gold. Walls block building there, but do NOT block projectiles.
help_guide.manage_tip: Move onto a defender or click it to select it. First aims furthest down the road; Strongest picks the most HP; Closest picks the nearest enemy.
help_guide.pace_tip: Waves start automatically. Pause to plan your next move, or send the next wave early for extra gold.
help_guide.rogue: Rogues have EVASION. Rogues take half damage from guns, arrows and slings until frost slows them. Put a Frost Mage where your shooters can hit enemies the frost slows down.  Blasts, lightning and Runeforge beams deal full damage even without frost.
help_guide.paladin: Paladins have PLATE. Plate blocks 75% of gun and sling damage, and 40% of arrow damage. Bring a Cannonier or Trebuchet for this one. Blasts, mines and magic deal full damage.
help_guide.centurion: Centurions have WARD. Ward blocks 80% of damage from frost, lightning and Runeforge beams. It renders magic nearly useless! Use Rangers, Gunners or siege against him.
help_guide.forge: Rotate with r while placing or after selecting. The beam burns every fighter along its line. Aim down a straight road; frost holds fighters in the beam. Centurion wards resist it.
help_guide.ogre: Put him beside a strong firing stretch. He pulls fighters backward through it. Heavy fighters move less; champions barely move.
help_guide.sapper: The crew plants mines nearby, even between waves. Blasts bypass plate and evasion. Selling the crew removes its mines.
help_guide.witch: She marks one fighter to take more damage from other defenders. She deals no damage herself. Strongest targeting helps focus on champions. Marks do not stack or remove plate and wards.
help_guide.limit: One of each specialist per defense. Selling frees its slot.
